note: Chinese public-hospital award records for soft-tissue surgical robots: one row per award, each read off the notice. This is the page's only proprietary dataset and it is a PRICE PANEL, never a shipment series — the portal searches titles only, has no API, rate-limits hard and refuses non-browser agents, and provincial platforms are unreachable from outside China, so coverage is a floor and never a count. Rules. (1) `contract_kind` is REQUIRED: purchase, lease or maintenance. A leasing award names the LEASING COMPANY as winner, leaves the brand column empty and prints a multi-year lease fee where a unit price belongs; without the kind that fee walks into an average selling price. A lease row must therefore have no brand and must say in its caveat that the figure is a lease fee. (2) A maintenance row carries no quantity — a service contract is not a shipment. (3) Keep only 中标/成交公告, never 招标 or 更正, and deduplicate on (hospital, project number): one procurement generates a chain of notices. (4) Quantity and prices are positive or null, never zero. (5) Record the notice URL, and where the figures came from a PDF attachment rather than the HTML, say so in `curator_notes`.

rows.caveat: Reported at the time as the lowest da Vinci award price in China, so it is an outlier by construction and must not be used as a typical price. It is hardware only and excludes the instrument and service revenue that dominates da Vinci lifetime economics. This is a media report of the award, not the government award notice itself, so the exact configuration and any bundled terms are not visible.
rows.curator_notes: IS4000CN is the China-manufactured da Vinci variant produced through the Intuitive Fuxing (直观复星) joint venture, which is why the report frames it as 国产达芬奇 — relevant if you are classifying domestic versus imported share, since this unit would plausibly count either way depending on the tracker's rule.

Hardware only. Reported secondhand rather than from the award notice, and the configuration behind the price is not stated.
rows.curator_notes: The Gansu and Ruijin pair bracket a roughly CNY 13m to CNY 19.8m range for da Vinci awards across six months, which is worth keeping in mind before treating any single award as a reference price.

The source is a commercial procurement-data vendor's marketing page, not a government award notice, and the brand behind this particular award is not stated on the page. The page's exact publication date is not shown, so the 2024 period is inferred from the award date it reports.
rows.curator_notes: The same page carries per-vendor average award prices that are useful for orientation but should be treated as vendor-tracker estimates rather than verified aggregates: 图迈 CNY 15.205m, 精锋 CNY 15.066m, 康多 CNY 10.67m. rows.source_name: 中国政府采购网 · 手术机器人（老年医院）中标公告
rows.caveat: The notice states no model and no surgical specialty — the 规格型号 cell is literally a slash. This row cannot be confirmed as soft-tissue from the document, and 佗道 also sells orthopaedic platforms. Keep it out of any soft-tissue price average until the attachment is read.

rows.hospital: 蚌埠医学院第二附属医院
rows.source_name: 中国政府采购网 · 上海市第一人民医院蚌埠医院内窥镜手术器械控制系统采购项目中标结果公告
rows.caveat: The notice contradicts itself: the headline award amount is 13,660,000 but the line-item table says 12,880,360, a 779,640 gap. The table figure is used here because it is the itemised robot line; the contract total is the larger number.

rows.brand: 瑞龙诺赋（上海）医疗科技有限公司/中国
rows.source_name: 中国政府采购网 · 浙江省肿瘤医院内窥镜手术器械控制系统项目中标结果公告
rows.caveat: The only 瑞龙诺赋 Ronovo award found in the entire search. One award at a provincial cancer centre is a beachhead, not a price level or a share position.

rows.hospital: 浙江大学医学院附属第一医院
rows.brand: 哈尔滨思哲睿智能医疗设备股份有限公司 中国
rows.source_name: 中国政府采购网 · 浙江大学医学院附属第一医院内窥镜手术器械控制系统中标结果公告
rows.caveat: The highest SR2000 award in the panel, 2.2x the 玉林 provincial-tender price for the same model. A top-tier teaching hospital paying the most for the cheapest-positioned domestic brand shows these figures track configuration and buyer, not vendor list price.

rows.source_name: 中国政府采购网 · 湖北省妇幼保健院医疗设备更新项目（内窥镜手术器械控制系统）中标结果公告
rows.caveat: Second-highest da Vinci award in the panel at a round 21.0M. Round numbers in these tables usually mean a contract cap rather than a computed unit price. Configuration undisclosed.

rows.source_name: 中国政府采购网 · 安庆市立医院腹腔内窥镜手术系统采购项目（二次）中标结果公告
rows.caveat: This is the rare notice where the robot line (12,077,000) is separable from the contract total (17,600,000) — the extra 5.52M buys unlisted items. Most rows in this panel do not offer that split, which is why headline award amounts systematically overstate machine prices.

rows.source_name: 中国政府采购网 · 上海市儿童医院腹腔内窥镜手术系统（手术机器人）的中标（成交）结果公告
rows.caveat: A paediatric hospital, but the notice does not indicate any paediatric-specific configuration or instrument set. Configuration undisclosed.

rows.hospital: 首都医科大学附属北京世纪坛医院
rows.source_name: 中国政府采购网 · 2025年世纪坛医院财政资金医用设备腹腔内窥镜手术系统采购项目中标公告
rows.caveat: No 品牌 column is printed; MP2000 is read as 精锋 from the model string alone. At 14.96M this is the highest plain-MP2000 award in the panel, 36% above the same model at 长治和平.

rows.brand: 直观复星医疗器械技术（上海）有限公司/中国上海
rows.source_name: 中国政府采购网 · 江苏省肿瘤医院关于腹腔内窥镜手术系统项目的中标公告
rows.caveat: This is a contract total, not a printed unit price — the notice leaves the 单价 cell empty. At 27.0M for quantity 1 it is the second-highest award here and almost certainly includes an instrument or service package the document does not list.

rows.source_name: 中国政府采购网 · 齐齐哈尔市中医医院采购腹腔内窥镜手术系统（手术机器人）结果公告
rows.caveat: KD-SR-01 is the earlier 康多 platform, not SR2000 — keep the two generations separate. This is a late-2024 award, so it predates the 2025-26 pricing in most of this panel.

rows.hospital: 上海市松江区中心医院
rows.source_name: 中国政府采购网 · 松江区中心医院手术机器人（腹腔内窥镜手术系统）（第二次）的中标（成交）结果公告
rows.caveat: An MT-1000 at 14.9M in late 2024 versus the same MT-1000 at 10.28M in the Guangdong provincial tender ten months later. That is the clearest domestic price-erosion signal in the panel, but two points do not make a trend line.

rows.source_name: 中国政府采购网 · 温州市人民医院腹腔内窥镜手术控制系统中标结果公告
rows.caveat: Awarded single-source after competitive procurement failed, so there was no price competition behind this number at all. It is the least market-tested figure in the panel.
